summary: Comprehensive testing of Hotel Review Management Dashboard with advanced AI Sentiment Analysis, Analytics Dashboard, and Competitor Benchmarking features completed successfully. Backend APIs working with 97.8% success rate (44/45 tests). Frontend UI fully functional with all new competitor-beating features operational.

flaky_endpoints.issue: PUT request returns 422 validation error when updating competitor
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Use DELETE and POST instead of PUT for competitor updates
